route_title: Bounded Aperiodic Stack with Quarter-Wave Initialized Thicknesses (24L)
compilation_rationale: Compiles a fixed 24-layer HfO2/SiO2 stack on Si with air incidence. Spectral sweep covers 3–13 µm. Initialization anchors near 8 µm quarter-wave optical thickness, truncated to the strict 2000 nm hard cap. Dual-band absorptance objectives drive mid-IR suppression and far-IR enhancement. Coherent TMM with smatrix solver ensures deterministic grading without requesting unprovided coefficients.
